sloka: चिच्छेद समरे वीरः चतुर्भिः चतुरो हयान् ।हत्वा च अश्वान् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः अर्थ चन्द्रेण सारथे ॥३-२६-८॥
transliteration: ciccheda samare vīraḥ caturbhiḥ caturo hayān ।hatvā ca aśvān śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ artha candreṇa sārathe ॥3-26-8॥

translations.english: After killing the horses with sharp arrows Rama severed the charioteer's head with an arrow of the shape of the crescent moon and pierced Dusana's chest with a set of three arrows.
